subject.title: feat: show provider plan usage (5h/weekly/credits) in the chat context popover, keep API cost for API billing

question: After the API-cost gating bug is fixed, should maintainers accept this additive provider usage API and chat popover plan-usage design as the canonical fix for the linked issue, or require a narrower split?
rationale: The PR changes provider usage routing, plugin API types, gateway status payloads, and a user-facing chat UI behavior under a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide the permanent product/API shape alone.

options.title: Repair and accept this PR shape
options.body: Fix the API-billed-session cost suppression, keep the additive usage metadata contract, and use this PR as the canonical fix for the linked issue.

options.title: Split backend usage from UI redesign
options.body: Land a narrower `claude-cli` usage/auth-status repair first and review the popover redesign as a separate product change.

options.title: Hold for a broader cost-control design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a different cross-provider billing model before exposing plan windows in the chat popover.

recommendation.body: Fix the API-billed-session cost suppression, keep the additive usage metadata contract, and use this PR as the canonical fix for the linked issue.
